title: post apiv1authregister with valid data
description: Test registering a new teacher account with valid email, full name, and password. Verify response includes teacher profile, teacher_code, and onboarding state, and that a 30-day trial subscription is created.

title: post apiv1authlogin with valid credentials
description: Test user login with correct email and password. Verify response returns JWT access_token, refresh_token, and token_type as bearer.

title: get apiv1authme with valid access token
description: Test retrieving the current authenticated teacher's profile using a valid access token. Verify response includes user details such as id, email, full_name, role, teacher_code, is_active, onboarding_completed, subjects, levels, created_at, and telegram_channel_id.

title: post apiv1authrefresh with valid refresh token
description: Test refreshing JWT tokens by sending a valid refresh_token. Verify response returns new access_token, refresh_token, and token_type as bearer.

title: post apiv1students create new student
description: Test creating a new student record with valid full_name and optional fields. Verify response returns the created student object with generated student code and hashed pin if provided.

title: get apiv1students list students
description: Test listing all students for the authenticated teacher with optional search and pagination parameters. Verify response returns an array of student objects.

title: post apiv1attendancebarcode mark attendance by barcode
description: Test marking attendance using a valid student barcode. Verify response returns an attendance record for today marked as present.

title: post apiv1lessonslessoniduploadvideo upload lesson video
description: Test uploading a video file to a lesson via Telegram integration. Verify response includes ok status, message_id, file_id, and video duration, and that the lesson is auto-published.

title: post apiv1subscriptionsactivate activate subscription code
description: Test activating a subscription using a valid subscription code. Verify response returns the created subscription object and associated plan object.

title: get apiv1dashboardstats get dashboard statistics
description: Test retrieving aggregated dashboard statistics for the authenticated teacher. Verify response includes counts for students, groups, today_attendance, pending_invoices, and active_exams.
